points.quote: The Ministry of Forests (FOR) will be contracting out work to rebuild a section of the Driftwood FSR north of Fort St James from 15.1km to 16.7km.

map_readings.label: WORK SITE
map_readings.shows: Upper overview map: an arrow from the WORK SITE box points to a spot on the green line of the Driftwood FSR.

map_readings.label: Driftwood FSR
map_readings.shows: Arrows from the Driftwood FSR boxes (overview map and inset map) point to the green road line.

map_readings.label: 68.5km Leo FSR
map_readings.shows: Upper overview map: an arrow from this box points to a place on a road; it is a reference label, with no closure or gate mark.

map_readings.label: Bridge Site approximately 15km - Start of Work Area
map_readings.shows: Lower inset map: an arrow points to the green Driftwood FSR line where the work area starts.

map_readings.label: End of Work Area - Approximately 16.7km
map_readings.shows: Lower inset map: an arrow points to the green Driftwood FSR line where the work area ends.

map_readings.label: Detour Route
map_readings.shows: Lower inset map: two arrows labelled Detour Route point to a grey line drawn as a bypass around the work area.

map_readings.label: Tchentlo FSR
map_readings.shows: Lower inset map: a magenta road line labelled Tchentlo FSR; no closure or gate mark.
